strings.zh: 水晶『呀,是{VAR:0103:0}前辈！{NEWLINE}我听说你最近都挺忙的,{CLEAR}怎么有空来孤儿院了呢？
strings.en: Crystal: Oh, it’s {VAR:0103:0}! I heard{NEWLINE}you’ve been really busy lately.{CLEAR}What brings you to the orphanage?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『是这样的,吉野市附近{NEWLINE}貌似有三圣兽活动的踪迹,{CLEAR}所以我就过来确认一下,{CLEAR}以防三圣兽被火箭队抓走。{CLEAR}你最近有发现吉野市周边{CLEAR}有什么异常吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Well, it looks like{NEWLINE}the legendary beasts have been{CLEAR}spotted near Cherrygrove City.{CLEAR}I came to check it out, before{CLEAR}Team Rocket catches them.{SCROLL}Have you noticed anything{NEWLINE}strange around here lately?

strings.zh: 水晶『说起异常,{NEWLINE}最近城市西边的潮水涨落极其反常,{CLEAR}海风的风向也从常见的西风{CLEAR}变成了极少出现的北风。{CLEAR}如果这不是自然现象的话,{CLEAR}就有可能是三圣兽在附近造成的。
strings.en: Crystal: Now that you mention it,{NEWLINE}the tides west of the city have been{CLEAR}really odd lately. And the sea wind has{CLEAR}switched from the usual west wind to a{CLEAR}north wind, which we almost never get.{SCROLL}If that’s not natural, the legendary{NEWLINE}beasts could be causing it.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『西边的海与风……{NEWLINE}会是水君造成的吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: The sea and wind to{NEWLINE}the west... Could it be Suicune?

strings.zh: 水晶『按三圣兽属性来说的话,{NEWLINE}就只可能是水君了。{CLEAR}正好我现在也有空,{CLEAR}就陪前辈一起在这附近{CLEAR}找找水君怎么样？
strings.en: Crystal: Going by the beasts’{NEWLINE}types, it could only be Suicune. I’m{CLEAR}free right now, so how about I help{CLEAR}you search for Suicune around here?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好啊,有你帮忙一定事半功倍。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sure. With your{NEWLINE}help, this’ll be twice as easy.

strings.zh: 水晶『嗯,那咱们现在就走吧！
strings.en: Crystal: OK, let’s go right now!

strings.zh: 水晶『没想到水君会选择我{NEWLINE}成为它的训练家,{CLEAR}这真是莫大的荣幸！
strings.en: Crystal: I never thought{NEWLINE}Suicune would choose me as its{CLEAR}Trainer. It’s such an honor!

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈,最近我一直{NEWLINE}在帮空木博士整理精灵资料,{CLEAR}都没怎么进行对战训练,{CLEAR}再这样下去就生疏啦。{CLEAR}你现在如果有时间的话,{CLEAR}能跟我来一场对战帮我锻炼一下吗？
strings.en: Crystal: Lately I’ve been helping{NEWLINE}Professor Elm sort his Pokémon data,{CLEAR}and I’ve hardly done any battle{CLEAR}training. At this rate I’ll get rusty!{SCROLL}If you have time now, could you{NEWLINE}battle me and help me train?

strings.zh: 水晶『我会认真对待这次训练的,{NEWLINE}前辈你可不要手下留情哦。
strings.en: Crystal: I’ll take this{NEWLINE}training seriously. So don’t{CLEAR}you dare go easy on me!

strings.zh: 水晶『看来我要学的还有很多啊,{NEWLINE}谢谢前辈指教。
strings.en: Crystal: Looks like I still have a lot{NEWLINE}to learn. Thank you for the lesson!

strings.zh: 水晶『{VAR:0103:0}前辈你来啦！{NEWLINE}最近我一直在帮空木博士整理资料时,{CLEAR}总是不能静下心来,{CLEAR}可能……是因为一直在想你吧。{CLEAR}现在能见到你我真开心！
strings.en: Crystal: {VAR:0103:0}, you’re here! Lately,{NEWLINE}when I’m sorting data for Professor{CLEAR}Elm, I just can’t concentrate. Maybe...{CLEAR}it’s because I keep thinking about you.{SCROLL}I’m so happy I get to see you now!
